text:
**Short answer:** For most people, WIRED's top pick is the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand. If you want 25 W fast charging, the ESR CryoBoost is the best value of the options I found.

## Top picks

- **Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand, about $98 (list $109).** It has a chrome tree design, charges the iPhone at 15 W, fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 and newer, and has an AirPods pad on the base. The iPhone pad tilts and supports landscape StandBy mode. It has a 2-year warranty. [WIRED review and shop links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

- **Best value with 25 W: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 25 W, $99.99.** It includes a 50 W adapter and a quiet cooling fan with an off button for bedtime. WIRED calls it a decent travel charger but says the plastic doesn't feel premium and the speed boost matters little if you charge overnight. A deal site lists code PARTNER18 for $82.00, but I couldn't verify that code myself, and that site is paid if you buy through its link. [Buy ESR CryoBoost (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) · [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

- **Fastest and most premium: Nomad Stand One Max, $169.** It charges at 25 W and has a glossy, heavy base you can lift your phone from one-handed. It doesn't include a power adapter, so you need a 40 W one (Nomad's is $25). [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

- **Best on a budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 (15 W), about $40 on sale (list $80).** It's the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 WIRED has found. The Watch charger is a detachable unit and the warranty is only 1 year. WIRED says the 25 W version costs far more for very little gain. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## Other options

- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25 W), $129.99:** Macworld says it's the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand, with a 45 W adapter included. It also works as a travel charger. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **Nimble Podium, $130–$140:** It lies flat so no screens light up at night. Watch charging is slow, so it's best left overnight. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2, 15 W), about $80:** A compact folding option for travel. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

## Things to check

- **25 W only helps newer iPhones.** The 25 W Qi2.2 speed applies to the iPhone 16 and 17 series, so it's wasted on older phones.
- **Your AirPods case must support wireless charging** to use the base pad.
- **Prices change.** Those above come from the articles' listings and may differ at checkout.
- **One source overstates its case.** The Dealectric page calls the ESR the "only product that fits," which isn't true given the other reviewed stands.

I only have direct purchase links for the ESR. For the others, the review pages above link to retailers.
